notes: Sourced from Panasonic's own official spec sheet PDF (86SQ1W_PHK_03, 17/03/2022, hosted on eu.connect.panasonic.com) — the authoritative manufacturer document, including the rear-panel "Drawing of terminals" diagram used to confirm exact port labels/layout. Caveats: (1) HDMI (hdmi-2.0) and DisplayPort (dp-1.2) grades are inferred, not printed verbatim as a version number in the datasheet — inferred from HDCP2.2 support and the documented plug-and-play timing table, which confirms clean 4K/60p (3840x2160 and 4096x2160) support at a 594MHz dot clock without needing 4:2:0 subsampling (that restriction applies only to the Digital Link path), consistent with HDMI2.0/DP1.2-class bandwidth rather than 1.4-class. (2) The AC inlet's exact silkscreen label and connector sub-type (assumed IEC C13/C14) were not visible in the retrieved terminal diagram, which covers only the signal/control cluster; inferred from the "detachable ~2.0m AC cord" included accessory and the unit's power class (480W/494VA). (3) Two USB Type-A ports are both labeled "USB" on the physical panel; distinguished here as Lower/Upper per Panasonic's own terminal-position table (they differ only in available bus power: 2A vs 1A). (4) The display also has an internal Intel SDM (Smart Display Module) expansion slot for optional plug-in PC/compute modules — omitted from the port list since it's an internal card slot, not an external cable connector. (5) Desktop/wall-mount unit only; not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted. (6) This TH-86SQ1W is the "W" (HDCP2.2 + Digital Link) variant of the SQ1 series; the plain TH-86SQ1 (no W) sibling differs on HDCP/Digital-Link support — confirm you have the right variant if cross-referencing other SQ1-series docs.
